name: reviewloop
description: Drive a PR to all-clear across every reviewer: Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot, other bots, and humans.

interface.shortDescription: Drive PR review feedback to a clear state
interface.longDescription: reviewloop drives a pull request to a fully-clear state across every reviewer, including Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot, other bots, and humans. It re-triggers bots, polls them, addresses actionable feedback, and hands back when human reviewers are waiting.
